name: gTrade
description: gTrade is the leveraged trading platform of Gains Network, offering synthetic perpetuals on crypto, forex, stocks and commodities on Arbitrum, Base, Polygon and ApeChain, with liquidity supplied by gToken vaults.
description_zh: gTrade 是 Gains Network 的杠杆交易平台，在 Arbitrum、Base、Polygon 和 ApeChain 上提供加密货币、外汇、股票和大宗商品的合成永续合约，流动性由 gToken 金库提供。

geo_feature.scope: Stock and index pairs: the app asks gTrade's geoblock API (wrkr.randomdegenerator.xyz/main/api/geo) for per-group flags and blocks the pairs of a flagged group. The flagged groups by country are those of the live probe (see the observations; 2026-10-12, 62 countries: stocks and indices in US, CU, IR, SY).

notes: Closed frontend. Market-group flags per country come from gTrade's geoblock API; the Terms (2.6) also reserve blocking by IP, ISP or VPN.
live: wrkr.randomdegenerator.xyz/main/api/geo (2026-10-12): US -> stocks:true, indices:true; RO GB DE FR NL CA JP AU SG HK KR IN AE TR UA BR AR NG -> all false
